move: three type bands marquee in alternating directions, seamless one-unit seam
how: A saturated blue frame with three 150px uppercase bands: solid white words with yellow dot separators on the top and bottom rows, outlined (text-stroke) words on the middle row. Each band's track repeats the four-word unit three times. seek(t) measures the unit width once, then sets x linearly: the outer bands move left by exactly one unit width over the 1s duration, the middle band moves right by the same amount, so frame D equals frame 0 and the marquee is seamless. No eases, no entry or exit.
adapt: Change the word list, colours, which band is outlined, band count and font size; duration sets the speed (one unit per D). Keep the linear motion and measured unit width so the seam stays invisible.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the bands and fills each track with the unit repeated three times, measuring unit width after layout; animate(el, shot, D) returns a gsap.timeline with three fromTo x tweens of duration D and ease 'none' (or one proxy tween with onUpdate). Scope gsap.utils.toArray('.track') to el; widths depend on el being laid out before measuring.
caveats: unit width is measured with getBoundingClientRect, so measure after the font has loaded and el is in the document
no entry or exit; it is a pure marquee
